WITH ENCO AS
(SELECT DISTINCT
HE277.E277_CLM_ID,
DATE(HE277.E277_ADD_TS) AS RSLT_DT,
HE277.E277_REF02_SRV_LN_NUM,
HE277.E277_STC01_2_INDUS_CD AS ERR_CD,
HMSG.EEM_DESC
FROM HS.E277_EMT_277CA_ERR AS HE277
JOIN HS.CDT_CLM_DT       AS CDT ON HE277.E277_CLM_ID = CDT.CDT_CLM_ID AND CDT.CDT_DT_QUAL = '050' AND CDT.CDT_DT >= CURRENT_DATE - 2 YEAR
JOIN HS.EEM_EDI_ERROR_MSG 	AS HMSG  	ON HE277.E277_STC01_2_INDUS_CD = HMSG.EEM_CODE AND HMSG.EEM_DEL_TS IS NULL AND HMSG.EEM_TYPE = '003'
WHERE HE277.E277_DEL_TS IS NULL 
UNION ALL
SELECT DISTINCT
HE277.E277_CLM_ID,
DATE(HE277.E277_ADD_TS) AS RSLT_DT,
HE277.E277_REF02_SRV_LN_NUM,
HE277.E277_STC10_2_INDUS_CD AS ERR_CD,
HMSG.EEM_DESC
FROM HS.E277_EMT_277CA_ERR AS HE277
JOIN HS.CDT_CLM_DT       AS CDT ON HE277.E277_CLM_ID = CDT.CDT_CLM_ID AND CDT.CDT_DT_QUAL = '050' AND CDT.CDT_DT >= CURRENT_DATE - 2 YEAR
JOIN HS.EEM_EDI_ERROR_MSG 	AS HMSG  	ON HE277.E277_STC10_2_INDUS_CD = HMSG.EEM_CODE AND HMSG.EEM_DEL_TS IS NULL AND HMSG.EEM_TYPE = '003'
WHERE HE277.E277_DEL_TS IS NULL 
UNION ALL
SELECT DISTINCT
HE277.E277_CLM_ID,
DATE(HE277.E277_ADD_TS) AS RSLT_DT,
HE277.E277_REF02_SRV_LN_NUM,
HE277.E277_STC11_2_INDUS_CD AS ERR_CD,
HMSG.EEM_DESC
FROM HS.E277_EMT_277CA_ERR AS HE277
JOIN HS.CDT_CLM_DT       AS CDT ON HE277.E277_CLM_ID = CDT.CDT_CLM_ID AND CDT.CDT_DT_QUAL = '050' AND CDT.CDT_DT >= CURRENT_DATE - 2 YEAR
JOIN HS.EEM_EDI_ERROR_MSG 	AS HMSG  	ON HE277.E277_STC11_2_INDUS_CD = HMSG.EEM_CODE AND HMSG.EEM_DEL_TS IS NULL AND HMSG.EEM_TYPE = '003'
WHERE HE277.E277_DEL_TS IS NULL 
WITH UR
)

SELECT DISTINCT
CLM.CLM_ID AS CLAIM_ID,
DATE(RES.CRS_ADD_TS)	AS "Encounter 277CA Response Date",
CASE
	WHEN RES.CRS_TYPE IN ('097','098','061','062') THEN 'Accepted'
	WHEN RES.CRS_TYPE IN ('096','060') THEN 'Rejected'
END 					AS "Encounter 277CA Response Result",

HE277.ERR_CD	AS "Encounter 277CA Header Error Code",
LE277.ERR_CD	AS "Encounter 277CA Line Error Code",
INITCAP(HE277.EEM_DESC)			AS "Encounter 277CA Header Error",
INITCAP(LE277.EEM_DESC)			AS "Encounter 277CA Line Error",
CASE
	WHEN HE277.ERR_CD IS NULL THEN LE277.ERR_CD
	WHEN LE277.ERR_CD IS NULL THEN HE277.ERR_CD
	ELSE HE277.ERR_CD || '-' || LE277.ERR_CD 
END 					AS "Encounter 277CA Error Code",
CASE
	WHEN HE277.EEM_DESC IS NULL THEN INITCAP(LE277.EEM_DESC)
	WHEN LE277.EEM_DESC IS NULL THEN INITCAP(HE277.EEM_DESC)
	ELSE INITCAP(HE277.EEM_DESC) || '-' || INITCAP(LE277.EEM_DESC)
END					AS "Encounter 277CA Error"

FROM 		HS.CLM_CLAIM		AS CLM
JOIN        HS.CDT_CLM_DT       AS CDT ON CLM.CLM_ID = CDT.CDT_CLM_ID AND CDT.CDT_DT_QUAL = '050' AND CDT.CDT_DT >= CURRENT_DATE - 2 YEAR
LEFT JOIN	HS.CRS_CLM_RESULT	AS RES ON CLM.CLM_ID = RES.CRS_CLM_ID AND RES.CRS_DEL_TS IS NULL AND RES.CRS_TYPE IN ('096','097','098','060','061','062') AND RES.CRS_USER_ID = 'EDI277CA'
LEFT JOIN	ENCO				AS HE277 ON CLM.CLM_ID = HE277.E277_CLM_ID AND HE277.RSLT_DT = DATE(RES.CRS_ADD_TS) AND HE277.E277_REF02_SRV_LN_NUM IS NULL AND RES.CRS_TYPE IN ('096','060')
LEFT JOIN	ENCO				AS LE277 ON CLM.CLM_ID = LE277.E277_CLM_ID AND LE277.RSLT_DT = DATE(RES.CRS_ADD_TS) AND LE277.E277_REF02_SRV_LN_NUM IS NOT NULL AND RES.CRS_TYPE IN ('096','060')

WITH UR
